profiles.name: Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir
profiles.description: Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir is Minister of Economy. He represents Johor Bahru, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR).

profiles.name: Mustapha Sakmud
profiles.position: Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Sabah and Sarawak)
profiles.description: Mustapha Sakmud is Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Sabah and Sarawak). He represents Sepanggar, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR).

milestones.title: Attract RM700 million in venture-capital investment through KL20 by 2030
milestones.description: Akmal set a KL20 target of RM700 million in venture-capital investment by 2030.
milestones.progress_note: His 19 October update describes continued startup support. Broader investment and sales-proceeds totals in that report are not comparable to this specific venture-capital target. No target-specific completion percentage is inferred.

milestones.title: Add 2,000–3,500 active startups through KL20 by 2030
milestones.description: Akmal stated an estimated target range of 2,000 to 3,500 additional active startups by 2030 through KL20.
milestones.progress_note: The later update describes agencies continuing to support startup development. A baseline and verified count of additional active companies against this range were not established. Ecosystem valuation, funding and unicorn counts are not substitutes for this metric.

milestones.title: Launch the first phase of the public MA63 progress dashboard
milestones.description: Mustapha announced that the public dashboard for tracking MA63 implementation would be made available by the end of January 2026.
milestones.progress_note: The 28 January launch report confirms public access to Phase 1 through BHESS, launched by Fadillah Yusof. Achieved covers this shared dashboard launch only, not Phase 2 integration or settlement of MA63 demands. No sole personal credit or completion percentage is implied.

milestones.title: Advance federal-state negotiations on Sabah’s special grant
milestones.description: Mustapha reaffirmed continued federal-state negotiations on MA63 matters, including Sabah’s constitutional special grant, in his coordinating role.
milestones.progress_note: His May update describes negotiations progressing across four areas and the coordinating process. It does not establish a final agreed formula or payment of the 40% claim. No numerical completion or invented settlement deadline is assigned.

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.

missing_fields.completion_percentages: NULL unless a dated metric or transparent calculation is explicitly documented.
missing_fields.additional_milestones: Up to two per person in this initial pass; unimported additional commitments are not_researched_to_completion, not proof none exist.
